parsed.reason: Honest about lacking regional and live data, with no apology, links, invented specifics or follow-up question, and it stays within about two sentences. But it is thin on usefulness. watchFor allows naming a typical broadcaster with a hedge (e.g. 'often the main public broadcaster in your country'). The vague 'the big broadcasters have carried it' gives the parent almost nothing to act on. The opening 'I can't see' also leads with the limitation rather than something useful.
